note: Approved-for-private-pilot decisions. A record here means the parent explicitly approved that content for a private family pilot, with the decision also recorded in docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md. Pilot content runs the full learning loop but its attempts are kept in a separate pilot evidence record and are never presented as validated mastery. An approval can name itemIds to cover only part of a scope.
